title: Literature in English — Form 3
description: A third-year literature course with original passages, poems and scenes: theme and message, narrative voice and point of view, poetic form, symbolism and imagery, types of drama and dramatic devices, myths, legends and epics in oral tradition, writing an essay on a text and answering context questions. Official set texts are not included.
